segments.text: In 2019, Facebook was fined five billion dollars. The largest penalty in FTC history.
Eighty-seven million people's data — harvested, profiled, and sold.
And on the day the fine was announced, Facebook's stock went up.
The market added six billion dollars in value.
Mark Zuckerberg personally gained one point one billion dollars in a single day.
The punishment made the company richer than if the government had done nothing.
To understand, you need to go back to 1977. The discovery started with a car on fire.
